verses.text: Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;

segments.text: Jehovah, remember for David

verses.text: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

segments.text: How he sware unto Jehovah,

verses.text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;

segments.text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house,

verses.text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;

segments.text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes,
Or slumber to mine eyelids;

verses.text: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.

segments.text: Until I find out a place for Jehovah,
A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.

verses.text: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.

segments.text: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah:

verses.text: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.

segments.text: We will go into his tabernacles;
We will worship at his footstool.

verses.text: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.

segments.text: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place;
Thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.

segments.text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness;
And let thy saints shout for joy.

verses.text: For thy servant David’s sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.

segments.text: For thy servant David’s sake
Turn not away the face of thine anointed.

verses.text: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

segments.text: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth;
He will not turn from it:
Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.text: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.

segments.text: If thy children will keep my covenant
And my testimony that I shall teach them,

verses.text: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.

segments.text: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion;

verses.text: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

segments.text: This is my resting-place for ever:
Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

segments.text: I will abundantly bless her provision:

verses.text: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

segments.text: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation;
And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

verses.text: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish.
